name: ACTS 17 Collective
description: Our mission is to make a case for Christ to leaders in technology and entertainment. We provide a relaxed and welcoming environment where leaders can explore the idea of faith and its relevance, regardless of their starting point. Ultimately, we are redefining success to those who define culture.

name: Basil Tech
description: Basil Tech exists to serve Jesus through technology. We do this in 3 ways: 1) We provide technology consulting to ministries and churches 2) We build innovative technologies to serve the church 3) We invest in discipling believers in tech to connect them with opportunities to use their gifts for the Kingdom

name: Bay Area Center for Faith, Work & Tech
description: We exist to cultivate faith and work integration in the Bay Area to transform people who are transforming the world.

name: BioLogos
description: BioLogos explores God’s Word and God’s World to inspire authentic faith for today. Our vision is faith and science working hand in hand.

name: Connect Silicon Valley
description: Our vision is to see Silicon Valley known not only as an epicenter of technological innovation and entrepreneurship, but also as a place transformed by the love of Jesus. Our mission is to catalyze the Great Commission among Silicon Valley young professionals through relationship driven experiences.

name: CW3
description: At Christians in Web3, we're a private, vetted, highly educated faith community on a quest to equip all generations with AI, Crypto, Blockchain, and Metaverse technologies to love our neighbors and build a better world. Our vision is to unite Christians who are building, investing, and ministering within the Web3 industry. Our mission is to pray, gather, and innovate so that technology leads all generation to Jesus

name: Faith & Work Movement Global
description: We help Christians faithfully represent Christ in their workplace together with other followers of Jesus who work in the same company. Together they can positively impact companies that impact the world.

name: Faith Driven Entrepreneur
description: As entrepreneurs, we follow in the footsteps of the Original Entrepreneur. From the very beginning, God created us to share in His entrepreneurial process with purpose, passion, and pursuit. He gives us ideas, dreams and ventures to reflect His image and bring about His glory. Faith Driven Entrepreneur exists to help shape the entrepreneurs who are shaping our culture to know God and look more like Him. In our pursuit, we adhere to the Lausanne Covenant which serves as a rallying cry for us to work together to make Jesus Christ known throughout the world. It is a covenant with one another, and a covenant with God himself.

name: FaithTech
description: FaithTech exists to see a Jesus revival awakened in and through tech by practicing redemptive technology design.

name: Generosity Bay Area
description: Generosity Bay Area inspires a culture of radical giving in the Bay Area— catalyzing a faithful community to joyfully imitate the generosity of Christ.

name: GoLiveServe
description: We send long-term and short-term business & tech professionals to serve in emerging economies that are mostly unreached nations. We also promote "work as globalocal mission" among churches through conferences, webinars & Sunday school curriculum.

name: Iona House
description: A place to reimagine all of life in reference to Christ Iona House is a 71 acre center for contemplation and Christian formation located in Placerville, CA. It is currently under development and operational. Iona House offers a unique experience of formation within a communal setting, rooted within the Great Tradition of Christianity, in which all of life is structured in reference to Christ.

name: Kingdom Haus
description: Through place and hospitality, KingdomHaus enables human flourishing by immersing and equipping people in Kingdom living. We cultivate deeply formed leaders, practicing God-powered living and imagination, and converging faith, vocation, family, and fun.

name: New College Berkeley
description: NCB is about discerning gospel-faithfulness together in the San Francisco Bay Area. We help the Church discern and contextualize the way of Christ, cultivating gospel imagination and spiritual friendship for our time.

name: Nexus Mentoring
description: Our Mission: Mentor people to discover their life design to flourish and make an impact in their communities. Our Purpose: Mentor young adults to discover their life design and activate their future.

name: Pray the Bay
description: Pray the Bay is a unifying prayer & worship movement for and through the local Church of the San Francisco Bay Area. We are believing for revival in the Church, renewal in our cities, and an awakening to the presence of God. We see a future of 24/7 prayer rooms with led prayer & worship sessions every morning, noon, and night in each region across the Bay.

name: Regent College - MALTS
description: The MA in Leadership, Theology & Society is a program designed to enable participants to remain in their current workplace while developing their leadership abilities through which they can bring transformation to their organizations and society.

name: Tech of Eden
description: At Tech of Eden, we nurture a community of the most influential AI stakeholders, thought-leaders, and innovators who have hearts open to Christ for a setting where iron sharpens iron. The forum is diverse and interdisciplinary, uniting the realms of business, law, academia, healthcare, and policy. We foster a safe and open space for critical discussions on what it looks like to plant faith, ethics, and values at the root of AI advancement and application in society. We encourage collaborative growth and collective imagination that moves us towards technology that reflects compassion, peace, transparency, and a commitment to humanity's flourishing—bringing us closer to Eden on Earth. We’re building a beacon of hope to the world that God is working for our good, even—and especially in—fields like AI.

name: The Institute for Innovation, Integration & Impact
description: Repurposing Business--Transforming Society

name: Transforming the Bay with Christ
description: Connecting and Equipping Leaders to help Ignite a Gospel Movement in the Bay Area
